description: When Claude Code hits its usage limit, Codex picks the task up from the same memory. Sno Station puts Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw on one squad: they hand work to each other and review each other's code. Open source, runs on your computer.
summary: Sno Station — your Claude Code and Codex working as one squad on your own machine. Shared encrypted memory, agent-to-agent messaging (Reach), squad skills for handoff and cross-vendor review, and a nightly loop that rewrites the agents' own skills with your approval. Open source, no daemon, no cloud
